Definition: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to swallow down; 1a2) to swallow up, engulf; 1b) (Niphal) to be swallowed up; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to swallow; 1c2) to swallow up, engulf; 1c3) squandering (fig.); 1d) (Pual) to be swallowed up; 1e) (Hithpael) to be ended
